operations.title: The intrinsic-prime trace is off-diagonal free propagation
operations.statement: For x>1/4, each Euler term e^(-sqrt(x)log n)/(2sqrt x) is the free one-dimensional resolvent kernel between logarithmic points 0 and log n. Its Stieltjes cut density cos(sqrt(t)log n)/(2pi sqrt t) changes sign, so it is not a positive diagonal resolvent. The prime trace requires a paired cross-channel block and cannot be a direct sum of positive prime measures.
operations.scope: Exact finite-cutoff off-diagonal realization and diagonal-positivity no-go; no completed self-adjoint block or positive Schur complement.

operations.title: Prime free-resolvent cut-density test
operations.description: Identify the Euler exponential with the free resolvent kernel and compute its sign-changing Stieltjes boundary density.
